mapper.select: select id, plant_id, code, name, type, x, y, status, description, sort_no, visible from nav.node where plant_id = #{plant_id} order by sort_no, id
select id, plant_id, code, name, group_name, level, from_node_id, to_node_id, points, one_way, enabled, sort_no from nav.road where plant_id = #{plant_id} order by sort_no, id
select id, plant_id, code, name, node_id, area, capacity, status, sort_no from nav.scale where plant_id = #{plant_id} order by sort_no, id
select id, plant_id, node_id, gate_mode, allowed_material_ids, sort_no from nav.gate where plant_id = #{plant_id} order by sort_no, id
select id, plant_id, code, name, direction, category, scale_id, backup_scale_ids, point_node_id, voice_text, enabled, sort_no from nav.material where plant_id = #{plant_id} order by sort_no, id
mapper.insert: insert into nav.plant (id, name, image_url, image_width, image_height, meters_per_pixel, remark, update_time) values (#{id}, #{name}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageWidth}, #{imageHeight}, #{metersPerPixel}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now()) on conflict (id) do update set name = excluded.name, image_url = excluded.image_url, image_width = excluded.image_width, image_height = excluded.image_height, meters_per_pixel = excluded.meters_per_pixel, remark = excluded.remark, update_time = now()

insert into nav.node (id, plant_id, code, name, type, x, y, status, description, sort_no, visible) values
(#{item.id}, #{item.plantId}, #{item.code,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.name}, #{item.type}, #{item.x}, #{item.y}, #{item.status,jdbcType=SMALLINT}, #{item.description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.sortNo,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{item.visible,jdbcType=BOOLEAN})

insert into nav.road (id, plant_id, code, name, group_name, level, from_node_id, to_node_id, points, one_way, enabled, sort_no) values
(#{item.id}, #{item.plantId}, #{item.code,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.name}, #{item.groupName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.level}, #{item.fromNodeId}, #{item.toNodeId}, #{item.points}, #{item.oneWay,jdbcType=SMALLINT}, #{item.enabled,jdbcType=SMALLINT}, #{item.sortNo,jdbcType=INTEGER})

insert into nav.scale (id, plant_id, code, name, node_id, area, capacity, status, sort_no) values
(#{item.id}, #{item.plantId}, #{item.code,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.name}, #{item.nodeId}, #{item.area,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.capacity,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.status,jdbcType=SMALLINT}, #{item.sortNo,jdbcType=INTEGER})

insert into nav.gate (id, plant_id, node_id, gate_mode, allowed_material_ids, sort_no) values
(#{item.id}, #{item.plantId}, #{item.nodeId}, #{item.gateMode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.allowedMaterialIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.sortNo,jdbcType=INTEGER})

insert into nav.material (id, plant_id, code, name, direction, category, scale_id, backup_scale_ids, point_node_id, voice_text, enabled, sort_no) values
(#{item.id}, #{item.plantId}, #{item.code,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.name}, #{item.direction}, #{item.category,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.scaleId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.backupScaleIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.pointNodeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.voiceText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.enabled,jdbcType=SMALLINT}, #{item.sortNo,jdbcType=INTEGER})
